pageless: MCP-callable seeded-sample demonstrator for the shared _prng bundle, no interactive UI of its own, presented through the shared MCP tool catalog (mcp.html). A node page would be an unlinked NAV-ISLAND-1 island until an ASSEMBLE row wires it into chaingraph-hub.html (ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec.0.1: demonstrators are page-less).
description: Derives a seeded sample of k distinct indices from [0, n) under one of three declared PRNG algorithm ids, echoing the algorithm id and a seed commitment (sha256 of the canonical seed string) in every output for the receipt. Modes: xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-v1 (decimal integer seed, |v| <= 2^53-1; bit-identical to the proven art-371 Monte Carlo generator, gated by a 20-seed stream differential), xoshiro256ss-splitmix64-sha256str-v1 (arbitrary UTF-8 string seed up to 256 bytes; state is the four big-endian words of SHA-256 of the seed), and hmac-drbg-sha256 (64-lowercase-hex derived seed; byte-identical to the sampler family's HMAC-SHA256 DRBG stream, art-774/art-583). Selection is exactly unbiased: threshold-rejection integer draws (no modulo bias) driving a partial Fisher-Yates, so exactly k accepted draws select k distinct indices with no draw cap (the art-583 v1 defects this construction replaces). n is bounded at 1,000,000 (a 4,000,000-byte guest index array); seed grammar violations, unknown algorithm ids and out-of-range n or k are refused with a closed reason code and no sample. The seed is always caller-declared replay tooling (seed_origin 'declared'); the beacon fairness ceremony is art-774's claim, not this node's. The kernel carries the _prng bundle verbatim (which itself embeds the _sha256 bundle verbatim), so the fixtures, property floor and execution_hash exercise the exact bytes other kernels will later inline.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false demonstrator node, art-775-seeded-sample-demonstrator, landed 2026-10-21 by SHARED-PRNG-BUNDLE-1. No GPU prove has been run and none is proposed here. Deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md); the node is not yet registered in the assembled graph, so the section 18 denominator does not see it and the ceiling moves in the ASSEMBLE-LAND that registers it (SO #59). GPU-CYCLE-PREFLIGHT-1 static pre-screen: no signature/hash verification loops, no policy_parameters-driven loop bound (n and k are range-checked against the fixed MAX_INDEX_ARRAY constant, and the walk consumes exactly k accepted draws plus sub-0.03% expected threshold rejects), no transcendentals; worst case is a 1,000,000-entry index walk with pure integer arithmetic (BigInt on the xoshiro modes, 32-bit integer HMAC draws on the DRBG mode) - measure user_cycles with runq-cpu exec before booking.
